messages:
Ivy Nguyen: Kicking off Cypress Therapeutics onboarding. Objective: pilot private inference for clinical form extraction + embeddings, ready for integration with their casework system by end of Q2. Need infra owner, SSO lead, compliance signoff, success criteria, and a short ROI snapshot for procurement. Please add missing folks.

Marco (Cypress): Our primary constraints: 30-day retention for test artifacts, Splunk forwarding for audit logs. Contacts: Marco (product), Pri (IT), Sasha (security).

Rina Patel: I'll be the CSM. Proposed success criteria: 1) SSO SAML for 12 pilot users, 2) p95 <= 380ms @256 tokens, 3) embeddings >= baseline on holdout set, 4) two enablement sessions + ops runbook.

Ethan (SE): I'll run perf harness and produce an ROI one-pager. Prefer private VPC deploy with KMS; ask Cypress about HSM. Need holdout set and sample docs.

Liam (AE): Renewal note: contract review in ~11 months. If we can't show deletion + logs + cost delta by week 6, renewal risk moves to medium. I need a 1-page ROI by week 5.

onboard-bot: Attached: https://redwood-internal.docs/cypress/onboarding/playbook-v1 \u2014 includes SSO runbook, perf harness, ROI template, compliance checklist.

Marco (Cypress): We'll share SSO metadata and holdout set by Tue. Splunk endpoint ready.

Ethan (SE): Sample perf command I'll run once endpoint is live:
```
./bench --endpoint https://sandbox.cypress.redwood/api/v1/generate --concurrency 6 --seq 256 --duration 300
```

Ivy Nguyen: Action items recap: - Ethan: perf + ROI 1-pager (after endpoints) - Rina: schedule enablement + capture feedback survey - Marco: share SSO + holdout set (due Tue) - Liam: prep renewal/procurement timeline (week 5)

Ethan (SE): Sandbox provisioning requested. ETA 72h; will post endpoint and rotated cred link here.

Rina Patel: Scheduling enablement tentatively week of May 16. I'll draft a 5-question feedback survey to capture enablement effectiveness.

Liam (AE): If we verify deletion + logs, I'll push for a pilot-to-prod clause in the contract.

onboard-bot: Reminder: "Security review" pending. Assign Zoe from security review.

Ivy Nguyen: Weekly sync Fridays 9am PT, first recap in 7 days. Locking thread to reduce noise; reply in meeting thread for new items.
